narr: A slow moving cold front continued to drop to the south and west, but low pressure developed along the boundary and there was still anomalously high amounts of moisture in place. Therefore, more heavy rain developed and this led to instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: MD-6 Port Tobacco Road was closed due to flooding near Maryland Point Road.
lsr: MD-6 PORT TOBACCO ROAD CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING NEAR MARYLAND POINT ROAD.
